alt: Dental technician hand-painting a prosthesis at a dark lab bench
why: Real hand-finishing of a prosthesis in low, moody light that suits the dark editorial palette.

alt: Dentist pointing at a panoramic X-ray on a monitor beside a patient
why: Panoramic X-ray is clearly on a screen, in a real clinic with a modern setting and a calm exchange.

alt: Woman holding an ice pack to her cheek at a sunlit desk
why: Adult at home with a cold compress in soft natural light, with an understated expression.

alt: Dentures soaking in a glass beside reading glasses
why: Dentures in a glass on a bedside table, with low-key light and a premium, lived-in still life.

alt: Implant-supported overdenture lifted above four implant abutments on a model
why: Shows the overdenture and the implants it clips onto clearly; a clean model shot.

alt: Zirconia bridge resting on three implant bases against black
why: Multi-tooth bridge on three implants on a black ground that matches the dark design; the crop trims the ends.

alt: Dental bridge model above prepared abutment teeth on a gum model
why: Shows plainly how a bridge fills a gap over abutment teeth, with a compact subject that crops well.

alt: Man brushing his teeth at a bathroom sink
why: Natural bathroom light and a man, which balances a set that leans female; everyday and unposed.
